reviewScope: All 1,678 source entries inventoried. All 1,677 nonempty images fully decoded and visually reviewed: 24 initial chronological contact sheets, 23 additional chronological sheets and a sheet of 34 repaired files. All 134 selected candidates compared again in 15 larger sheets at up to 492 pixels; the cover was also opened at 1,200 pixels. The remaining empty file and two visibly damaged frames are explicitly omitted.
dateSource: Camera-local EXIF DateTimeOriginal and OffsetTimeOriginal (+05:30), 4–8 January 2026. No dates inferred from filenames or file modification times.
locationNotes: The source collection includes the Visakhapatnam and Araku lead-in as well as the Chhattisgarh portion. The album title is Andhra Pradesh and Chhattisgarh; labels identify the actual photographed places.
Visible signs, landmarks, original GPS and capture order establish the route. Broad labels are used for the misty Araku viewpoint and the Bastar gorge rather than inventing a precise attraction.
Selected personal and incidental people photographs are listed in peoplePhotoSources for later review. Museum figures are described as figures rather than living people.
criteria: Choose distinct landscapes, forest paths, architecture, interiors, food and details; compare repeated bursts and retain a few personal scenes.
Aim for about ten frames per day/location where distinct strong photographs exist; retain shorter sections rather than repeating the same scene.
Keep the rainbow cover outside the gallery and count it once on its actual capture date.
Preserve framing, orientation and colour profiles. Export quality-84 WebP at 2,000 pixels on the long edge, or 2,400 for the cover; remove EXIF and XMP.
Publish only selected derivatives to R2; keep originals, review sheets, screenshots and credentials outside Git and R2.
